text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With the Takarazuka Kinen's chances of 
being held at Hanshin ruined, Rice Shower 
was seized with regret, believing her own 
"bad luck" was the cause.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower wished desperately for the 
Takarazuka Kinen to be held somehow, 
wanting to bring joy to the fans who 
supported her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She negotiated repeatedly with Hanshin 
Racecourse, Kyoto Racecourse, and 
Chairwoman Akikawa to somehow be allowed 
to hold the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Moved by Rice Shower's desperate efforts, 
people coordinated together to help her. 
As a result—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Takarazuka Kinen would proceed to be 
held safely at the Kyoto Racecourse.
